content.value_statement: Email campaigns can lose focus when timing, audience needs, and conversion goals are unclear. This skill creates structured sequences with practical copy and measurement guidance.
actual_capabilities: Plan welcome, onboarding, lead nurture, and re-engagement sequences with suggested lengths and delays.
Draft subject lines, preview text, email bodies, and one primary call to action per message.
Specify sequence triggers, goals, exit conditions, and per-email segment conditions.
Recommend personalization and audience segmentation by behavior, subscription stage, and profile.
Create testing and measurement plans for subject lines, timing, clicks, conversions, and unsubscribes.
Review lifecycle coverage with checklists for onboarding, retention, billing, usage, win-back, and campaign emails.
limitations: The included files provide writing guidance and templates, not an email delivery service or runnable automation.
Provider implementation requires separate tools, configuration, permissions, and review of linked integration guides.
Timing and performance benchmarks are starting points, not guarantees of engagement, deliverability, or revenue.
Cold outreach and in-app onboarding design are assigned to separate skills.

use_cases.title: Guide Trial Users Toward Activation
use_cases.description: Create onboarding emails that lead new trial users toward a first project, team invitation, or other defined activation step.

use_cases.title: Nurture Report Downloads Into Demo Requests
use_cases.description: Plan educational follow-ups after a report download, building toward a demo request with relevant content and verified customer examples.

use_cases.title: Reconnect With Inactive Subscribers
use_cases.description: Draft a re-engagement sequence that explains current value, invites subscribers to stay, and defines when to stop sending.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Welcome Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Write the first welcome email for [product] aimed at [audience]. Include a subject, preview, body, and one CTA for [first action].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create one email with a clear next step.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Trial Onboarding Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create five onboarding emails for [product] with a [duration]-day trial. Target [activation action]. Include timing, copy, CTA destinations, and exit conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: organize a complete trial email sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Nurture Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [sequence] for [audience] and [goal]. Identify weak timing, unclear CTAs, and repetitive copy. Rewrite weak emails and propose single-variable tests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: revise existing emails and define focused experiments.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Segmented Lifecycle Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Design onboarding, retention, and win-back flows for [product]. Segment by [behavior] and [plan]. Define triggers, exclusions, exits, copy, metrics, and test priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate multiple flows with segment rules and measurement.

output_examples.input: Write a welcome email for a project management trial. The first action is creating a project.
output: Subject: Create your first project in Taskboard
Preview: Give your team one place to organize its next project.
Body: Welcome to Taskboard. Start with one project your team is working on today. Add its name and first task to begin organizing the work.
CTA: Create my first project. Destination: Project creation page.

output_examples.input: Plan a three-email re-engagement sequence for consenting subscribers inactive for 60 days.
output: Trigger: 60 days without recorded engagement. Goal: Confirm interest. Exit: A subscriber confirms interest or unsubscribes.
Email 1, day 0: Share a useful recent resource. Subject: Your next weekly planning template. CTA: View the template.
Email 2, day 4: Explain relevant improvements. Subject: Two updates to your planning toolkit. CTA: Explore the updates.
Email 3, day 10: Ask whether to continue. Subject: Would you like to keep receiving our emails? CTA: Keep my subscription.
End condition: Stop marketing sends to nonresponders after the final confirmation window. Track clicks, confirmations, and unsubscribes.

best_practices: Provide the product, audience, entry trigger, conversion goal, and verified facts before requesting a sequence.
Give each email one primary purpose and CTA, with explicit segment conditions and sequence exit rules.
Test one variable at a time and assess conversions and unsubscribes alongside opens and clicks.
anti_patterns: Do not combine several unrelated offers or competing primary CTAs in one email.
Do not use fake reply prefixes, invented customer results, or unsupported urgency.
Do not publish drafts without checking consent, suppression rules, unsubscribe access, and actual destination links.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces sequence overviews, email copy, subject lines, preview text, CTA suggestions, segment conditions, and measurement plans.

faq.question: Does it send emails or configure automations?
faq.answer: The included files do not send emails or configure providers. Implementation requires separate tools and an authorized setup.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your product, audience, entry trigger, desired action, trial length if relevant, current emails, and available performance data.

faq.question: Can it use existing product context?
faq.answer: The skill directs the assistant to read an available local product-marketing context file before asking for missing task information.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing sequence?
faq.answer: Yes. It can apply copy, timing, segmentation, and testing guidance to your supplied emails. Actual performance requires campaign data and testing.

faq.question: Does it cover cold outreach or in-app onboarding?
faq.answer: Cold outreach and in-app onboarding design use separate skills. This skill handles lifecycle emails and email support for product onboarding.
